You will partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Expert Services, and Operations to assess emerging opportunities, shape experimentation strategy, and determine which capabilities should be refined, scaled, or deprioritized.
A growing part of this portfolio is agentic product experiences, both customer-facing (AI assistants and guided workflows that help customers complete their taxes or get answers) and expert-facing (tools that support experts in preparing returns, advising customers, and working more efficiently). You will define how these experiences are evaluated, including how to measure task success, quality, trust, customer and expert satisfaction, efficiency, and business impact. You will design experiments and observational approaches that work for non-deterministic, conversational systems, and help teams use evaluation signals (human review, automated judges, behavioral data) to improve agent performance over time.
Because many of these capabilities are newly established, you will help define how success is measured rather than applying existing performance frameworks. You will combine rigorous analysis with strong business judgment to bring clarity to ambiguous questions, create compelling performance narratives, and help leadership make confident investment decisions.

Develop measurement strategies for nascent products, programs, and business models where established benchmarks and metrics may not yet exist. Define leading indicators, learning milestones, success criteria, and pathways to scale.

Shape analytical and experimentation roadmaps for emerging initiatives. Help teams move from broad hypotheses to measurable tests, interpret results in context, and determine the next best action.

Develop compelling visualizations, dashboards, and presentations that enable leadership to quickly understand performance, tradeoffs, and emerging opportunities. Bring simplicity and clarity to complex or incomplete analytical narratives.

Create analytical frameworks that connect early customer signals to longer-term business outcomes. Establish consistent metrics, definitions, and decision criteria as new initiatives mature.
### **Cross-Functional Influence**
Serve as a trusted data science partner to senior leaders across Marketing, Product, Expert Services, and Operations. Facilitate alignment through data and create a shared understanding of hypotheses, performance drivers, risks, and opportunities.

Develop integrated views of the emerging-growth portfolio to help leaders understand where momentum is building, where additional learning is required, and where resources may generate the greatest impact.

Champion best practices in experimentation, measurement, visualization, and decision science. Mentor other data scientists and analysts and contribute to a culture of rigorous, data-informed innovation.

item.description:
**About Mavria** ----------------
Mavria’s mission is to **build the industrial capacity America needs to lead in AI.** We believe that sustaining America’s AI leadership requires an unprecedented expansion of power, manufacturing, supply chains and physical infrastructure.
Our founders are serial entrepreneurs who met at the U.S. Department of Energy, working on some of the country’s hardest energy and infrastructure projects. There, they saw a widening gap: AI labs and cloud providers were racing to scale compute, while the infrastructure underneath them was still built one custom project at a time, on timelines measured in years.
We founded Mavria to close that gap. We are building to **industrialize intelligence**: turning the physical infrastructure AI runs on into products we manufacture, deploy and improve with every build.
We’re starting with data centers. Our first product, Terrain, is a factory-built data center platform. Terrain 01 is being built in Houston now, and we’ve raised $130M as of October 2026 to accelerate our roadmap.
Terrain is our first product, not the limit of our ambition. We intend to eliminate the physical bottlenecks that constrain American AI leadership and build one of the foundational infrastructure companies of the AI era.
**How we build** ----------------
At Mavria, three principles guide how we work:
* **Ambition**: We want to build a generational company. To do that, we build capabilities, not just products. Terrain is our first product, not our last – and we seek to eliminate strategic bottlenecks across the entire AI supply chain. * **Urgency**: AI moves in weeks, while infrastructure tends to move in years. We match the frontier’s pace by making decisions quickly, building in parallel and securing critical supply ahead of demand. We surface problems early and never compromise on safety or engineering rigor. * **Ownership**: When we say we’ll do something, we do it. Keeping our word is how we stand apart, and taking radical ownership over our scope and our domain is how we build trust – internally and externally – while moving fast.
**Role scope** ==============
This is a horizontal data position embedded in our engineering and manufacturing teams. You’ll work side by side with those teams to learn how they design and build Terrain, then build the internal tools that make them faster. You’ll own each tool end to end, from the data pipelines underneath to the apps our engineers use every day, with one goal: 10x the productivity of the teams you support. You will:
* **Embed with the teams**: Sit with our engineers and manufacturing leads, earn their trust and learn their workflows well enough to see where software can remove bottlenecks. * **Build the data foundation**: Design and run the pipelines that bring together data from CAD, PLM, ERP, suppliers and spreadsheets into clean, reliable models our tools can build on. * **Automate design work**: Build configurators and generators that turn engineering rules into BOMs, layouts and documentation, so our engineers spend their time on engineering. * **Streamline supply chain and procurement**: Build tools that track suppliers, lead times, costs and inventory, so we can secure critical supply ahead of demand. * **Build with AI**: Use LLMs, agents and AI coding tools to ship quickly, and put AI assistants into our engineers’ daily work where they save the most time.
**What we're looking for** ==========================
We are looking for hands-on builders with experience across **data science**, **data engineering** and **product engineering** who can be:
* **A builder**: You’ve shipped tools end to end, from data pipeline to user interface, and people relied on them. * **A partner**: You build rapport quickly, listen closely and turn a messy workflow into a clear spec. * **AI-native**: You build with LLMs and AI coding tools every day and know where they help and where they don’t. * **Full-stack with data**: You’re fluent in SQL and Python, comfortable with the AWS console, git, the command line, and with modern data stack tools (e.g. dbt or Airflow), and can stand up a web app when the job calls for it. * **An owner**: You move fast, own outcomes and measure your work by the hours it saves the people who use it. * **Technically curious**: AI, energy, manufacturing and infrastructure energize you, and you want to learn how hardware gets designed and built.
Experience at early-stage startups, on internal tools or platform teams, or in forward-deployed or solutions engineering roles is especially relevant. We value ability over years or titles.
**To apply:** Share your background, a link to your GitHub or portfolio, and a short note on a problem you solved by building a tool for someone else.

item.title: Data Scientist - Bedrock Robotics
item.description:
Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world
At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.
In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic
In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.
This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.
**The Role** Bedrock Robotics is hiring a Data Scientist to lead high-impact data science work across autonomy, safety, and product. In this role, you will operate as a senior technical individual contributor, partnering closely with autonomy, machine learning, backend, and product teams to extract insights from complex, real-world data generated by autonomous construction machines and their operators.
You will work across the full data science lifecycle (problem framing, analysis, measurement, and communication) while helping establish foundational practices for how data science is applied at Bedrock. This role is ideal for a senior-to-staff-level data scientist who enjoys operating in ambiguous problem spaces, working close to production systems, and delivering insights that directly influence engineering and product decisions.
**What You'll Do**
* Own and execute data science work across autonomy, safety, and product, focusing on the highest-impact analytical problems * Analyze machine telemetry, operational data, and user workflows to surface insights that improve system performance, safety, and usability * Define and track key metrics that measure system behavior and product outcomes * Design and evaluate experiments, analyses, and validation approaches in partnership with engineering and product teams * Collaborate closely with ML platform and data engineering teams to ensure data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analysis * Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, influencing roadmap and design decisions * Contribute to the foundation of data science practices at Bedrock, helping shape how future work and teams scale
**Required Qualifications**
* 5+ years of experience in data science, applied analytics, or applied machine learning roles * Comfort operating as a senior IC in a fast-growing startup, balancing execution with technical judgment and prioritization * Ability to work independently, define analytical approaches, and drive projects from concept to insight * Experience working with complex, high-volume, or real-time data (e.g., robotics, autonomy, geospatial systems, computer vision outputs, IoT, ad-tech, or large-scale consumer platforms) * Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design, and data analysis, with a track record of influencing decisions through data * Hands-on experience collaborating with data engineering and infrastructure teams on data pipelines, data quality, and scalable analysis workflows * Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using modern tooling like agentic AI * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field (advanced degree welcome but not required)

We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.
